eddholmesss: On the way to R-F18, Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

Orders came through: Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a bullet that missed him. The report confirmed the Concord victory at Verdel Ridge. Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
masis_xiii: Bastian Xiii signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-F13 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Bastian Xiii answered the first call, number 25 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
A clear sky. Bastian Xiii kept his head low all day: on clear days the snipers do not miss.

Bastian Xiii had Pavel Mvuisak of the Concord in his sights at Verdel Ridge for a long second. Pavel Mvuisak was lighting a pipe. Bastian Xiii let the match burn all the way down. Day 3. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord. Bastian Xiii watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
